title: Whole Filament and Four Windowed Locules Anther
description: One wholly newly authored enlarged complete detached stamen teaching cutaway. Its gently bowed whole filament continues into the central connective, supporting two thecae with two elongated pollen-sac wall shells apiece. All four sacs retain their full rounded longitudinal extent, actual inner cavities and finite wall thickness. A broad outward-facing window is deliberately authored in each sac to reveal the cavity; these are artificial educational cutaways, not natural dehiscence slits, removed old mesh pieces or an exploded partial assembly. All filament profile, four-sac arrangement, cavity topology and cut margins are new; no hibiscus central column, fern sporangium capsule or old pine pollen grain is extracted or reused. One complete stamen model and zero scenes, not a complete flower or plant. Five closed editable meshes, four restrained opaque material roles and no separate sac counts. Generic regularized lily-like four-sac plan, not a named specimen, measured scale or universal angiosperm arrangement. Pollen grains, tapetum, vascular cells, microscopic layered walls, development and release mechanisms are omitted rather than falsely reconstructed. The basal filament cut defines the art placement plane only, not a natural standing pose. No labels, textures, transparency, rig, animation, pollen production, germination, medical, diagnostic or physical simulation claim.
